upstream.description: Bash is all you need -  A nano claude code–like 「agent harness」, built from 0 to 1

classification.analysis: A structured, multi-language (English/Chinese/Japanese) tutorial series that teaches how to build an agent harness from scratch, mirroring Claude Code's architecture: the agent loop, tool use, permissions, hooks, todo tracking, subagents, context compaction, task systems, and worktree isolation, each as a runnable Python lesson with an accompanying README and diagrams. It's aimed at engineers who want to understand agent-harness engineering, as distinct from prompt-chaining frameworks, by building the mechanisms themselves rather than reading about them abstractly. An extremely popular educational repo (74k+ stars) with a companion learn.shareai.run site.

use_cases.title: Learn how Claude Code's agent loop actually works
Build a minimal coding-agent harness step by step
Study subagent and worktree isolation patterns
Teach a team the mechanics behind agent tooling
